paragraphs: Fostering for children in care in Northampton is run by Northamptonshire Children's Trust, which works with West Northamptonshire Council and North Northamptonshire Council and trains and supports the county's own foster carers and people who want to foster. The independent services listed above also cover Northampton.

The trust and the two councils run recruitment together. During Foster Care Fortnight in May 2026, under the national theme "This Is Fostering", they shared local carers' stories and held a fostering information evening at the Old Savoy Theatre in Northampton, where people could talk to experienced carers and staff. The trust also launched a Fostering Friendly Pledge that June, inviting local businesses to offer foster carers discounts, wellbeing support or flexible services.

Fostering alongside a job is common. West Northamptonshire Council was recognised by The Fostering Network as a Fostering Friendly employer in 2023, changing its staff policies to give employees who foster more support, and it noted that nearly 40 per cent of foster carers combine fostering with other work.

The trust's website explains how to register interest, the types of fostering available, its training and support and its open evenings. Speak to the trust and to two or three of the services above before you choose, and see the Northamptonshire page for services across the wider county.
